evidence.statement: The preregistered MOP16-14-v1 real three-domain vocabulary contains 618,470 distinct shared token types.
Five exact-dinucleotide-preserving null triplets produce 421,985; 417,911; 421,935; 425,242; and 423,492 shared token types.
Real exceeds the null maximum by 193,228 token types (1.4544x) and exceeds the null mean by 1.4652x.
All 120 wildcard masks individually exceed the maximum of their five matched null counts; both adjacent-mask and separated-mask diagnostic families also show ~1.45x real/null-max separation.
The variable-slot layer is not being driven by one favorable wildcard pattern: the enrichment is distributed across the entire predeclared mask family.

unknowns: Biological composition of the frozen 618,470-token candidate set.
